title: Agent identity (v1)
description: Who an agent is, who owns it, and how much autonomy it has. What it may do is not stated here; see tool-call-policy-rule.

agent_id.description: Stable, unique, lowercase kebab-case. Never reused after retirement.

version.description: Semantic version of the agent's behavior (prompt, model, tools).

autonomy.description: Whether a human approves before the action takes effect, after it, or not at all.

model.description: Optional model identifier the agent runs on.
